tha-ap519:1.1: samattaṃ. [514. Kuṭajapupphiya.] Himavantass' avidūre Cāvalo nāma pabbato / Buddho Sudassano nāma vasate pabbatantare. // //
tha-ap519:2.1: Pupphaṃ hemavataṃ gayha vehāsaṃ agamās' ahaṃ / tatth' addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ oghatiṇṇam anāsavaṃ. // //
tha-ap519:3.1: Pupphaṃ kuṭajam ādāya sire katvān' ahan tadā / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ sayambhussa mahesino. // //
tha-ap519:4.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ pupphaṃ abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap519:8.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kuṭajapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
